meta.name: google-ads-strategy
meta.description: Run Google Search Ads end-to-end: keyword mining, account structure, ad copy, negative keyword architecture, and performance analysis. Covers the full loop from setup to ongoing optimization for B2B SaaS and app makers. Use when the user wants to plan, launch, or optimize Google Search campaigns, or understand how the platform works before spending. Not for Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Google Display/YouTube campaigns.

copy.tagline: 规划、启动并优化谷歌搜索广告全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责谷歌搜索广告的策划、投放或优化工作
copy.tagline_en: Plan, launch, and optimize Google Search Ads end-to-end
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Search Ads from setup to optimization

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成 Google 搜索广告的完整流程：关键词挖掘、账户结构、广告文案、否定关键词和效果分析。它会先询问你的情况，再给出定制建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“谷歌广告”、“搜索广告”、“关键词研究”、“否定关键词”、“质量得分”等触发词，或要求规划、启动、优化 Google 搜索广告时触发。

say.text: 帮我做 Google 搜索广告的关键词研究。
say.note: Claude 会加载关键词挖掘指南。

say.text: 我的广告效果不好，帮我分析一下。
say.note: Claude 会加载效果分析指南。
Claude 会加载账户结构指南。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through the full Google Search Ads workflow: keyword mining, account structure, ad copy, negative keywords, and performance analysis. It asks about your situation first, then tailors recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention triggers like 'google ads', 'search ads', 'keyword research', 'negative keywords', 'quality score', or ask to plan, launch, or optimize Google Search campaigns.

say_en.text: Help me do keyword research for Google Search Ads.
say_en.note: Claude loads the keyword mining guide.

say_en.text: My ads aren't working, help me analyze.
say_en.note: Claude loads the performance analysis guide.

say_en.text: How should I structure my ad groups?
say_en.note: Claude loads the account structure guide.
